transcript:
**Agent:** Hi there! Thank you for calling TechSolutions. This is Lisa. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi, Lisa. I’m having trouble logging into my account. I keep getting locked out.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that! Can I have your email address to look into your account?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s janedoe@example.com. I’ve tried resetting my password, but it still doesn’t work.

**Agent:** Thank you, Jane. Let me check your account. It looks like there was a recent security update. I can send you a temporary password to regain access.

**Customer:** That would be great, thanks! I really need to access the reports for my team.

**Agent:** No problem! I’ll send that temporary password to your email now. Also, while I have you on the line, have you considered upgrading to our Pro Plan? It includes advanced reporting features.

**Customer:** I’m not really interested in upgrading right now. I just want to get back into my account!

**Agent:** I completely understand. Your temporary password will be in your inbox shortly. Once you’re logged back in, feel free to explore the upgrade options later.

**Customer:** Okay, I’ll do that. By the way, can I expect the password in the next few minutes?

**Agent:** Yes, it should arrive within a couple of minutes. If you don’t see it, please check your spam folder.

**Customer:** Got it! I really appreciate your help today, Lisa.

**Agent:** You’re welcome, Jane! I’m glad I could assist you. If you have any more questions later, don’t hesitate to call us.

**Customer:** Will do! Thanks again. Have a great day!

**Agent:** You too, Jane! Take care.
